note: No fact: the article says EDUSER is meant to ease pupil identification nationally and was demonstrated on 5 February 2026, with deployment still being discussed, but never says schools enter per-learner records into it, so it is left unclassified. It reports as SERNIE's difficulties no real-time data flow, unsuitable IT tools and few operational partners, and that pupil tracking rests on paper documents (bulletin, palmarès, minutes, pupil card), without saying learner records are on paper only.
